purpose: Persist and publish an immutable assessment of every local legacy Trade order and every nonzero benefit component without importing canonical benefit history.
invariants: one immutable candidate per local legacy Trade order in the tenant snapshot
one component per nonzero generic discount, coupon, point, or VIP amount
source benefit amount equals component amount exactly, including quarantined encodings
identical command replay returns the first immutable result and emits no duplicate events
policy v2 event assessed_at equals the persisted candidate assessment time
candidate and component import authority always remains false
the local Yudao Trade snapshot is never labeled as the Y-Shopping discount fact source
forbidden_shortcuts: inventing a canonical Order or OrderItem mapping
treating activity or coupon IDs without a version as canonical benefit identity
inventing platform or merchant funding splits
normalizing negative or inconsistent historical money without quarantine
authorizing production import from assessment evidence
cleanup: No destructive cleanup. Operation, run, candidates, components, Outbox events, lakehouse projections, and the external ledger remain audit evidence.
